observations: body L2: the full stop after «Varāhamihira» stands for a comma; the title «Pañcasiddhāntikā» is spelt Pañchasiddhāntikā in note 1, as on p. 206.

body L3, L5-L10, L12, L20, L22-L25, L29, L35-L36: the dashes of the transliterated names, of «Pauliśa–Siddhānta», «Brahma–Siddhānta», «as–Sindhind», «phil.–hist.», «XLIV–XLVI» and of the number ranges are long dashes (4.7 to 5.8 pt); in L29 «12-13» has a hyphen (3.4 pt).
body L7, L10: specks stand below «autem» and «quadrante».
body L10-L12: 365 days, a quarter of a day, a fifth of an hour and 1/400 of an hour make 365d 6h 12m 9s; 729s are 12m 9s, so the Roman year of 365d 6h with 729s added is the same year.
body L13: the sign of the days after 365 is printed as an italic g.
body L16: 120 : 4 = 30, so a month of 30 days added every 120 years gives the year of 365 1/4 days.
body L18: no full stop is printed after «buisse».

body L30-L35: the quarter days make a month of 30 days in 120 years and the fifths of an hour a further day in the same 120 years; both together make 30 days in 30 : (1/4 + 1/120) = 116.13 years, so «116 annis» is right; 365 1/4 days + 1/5 hour is 365d 6h 12m.

notes_left L2-L3: the dashes of «1-3» (4.0 pt) and of the range divided between the lines («11-», «-13», 3.6 and 3.8 pt) have the length of the hyphens of compound words in the notes (3.4 pt in St.-Pétersbourg, p. 172) and are transcribed as hyphens; the hyphen of the range is repeated at the head of L3.
notes_left L3, L7: the dash of «Pauliśa-Siddhānta» measures 3.1 pt, a hyphen, that of «al–Bīrūnī» 4.3 pt, a long dash; the hyphens at the line ends of the notes are shorter, 2.0 to 2.8 pt.
notes_right L1-L7: the dashes of the transliterated names (3.1 to 3.8 pt) and of «43-44» and «53-55» (3.2 pt) are hyphens.

notes_right L3: by the arithmetical Islamic calendar 27 ramaḍān 845 is 8 February 1442 (Julian); a month counted from the sighting of the crescent can begin a day later, which gives the 9 February printed.

transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
